name: Precision Automotive
hook: Your customers on Andrew Johnson Highway drop the car at night and know James will find the fault — the ones who don't know you yet could see his credentials, your warranty and a booking button from their phone. We built a trial version of that page. Take a look:
fakt: you founded Precision Automotive in 2009 as an ASE Master Technician with 25 years in the trade, you cover everything from computer diagnostics to steering and suspension with a 12-month/12,000-mile warranty, and you offer towing and night drop
na_stronie: your name, phone and e-mail, eight services in your own words (complete computer diagnostics, complete safety analysis, drivability problems, tune-ups, oil changes, brake repair, steering and suspension, scheduled maintenance), James's ASE Master credentials and Amy at the desk on the about page, the 12-month/12,000-mile warranty, towing and night drop, online booking Tuesday to Friday 8 am–6 pm and a contact form — every request lands straight in your inbox; your own photos we add from you
dlaczego: An ASE Master owner with a written warranty is the strongest thing a two-person shop can say online. A page that says it clearly, with night-drop and online booking, brings in the customers who search Morristown after hours.
